soul.ann_html: Pre-launch · not CE-certified yet · waitlist only, nothing is charged.
soul.hero_h1_html:
your ai has a brain.
give it a soul.
soul.hero_lead: A palm-sized aluminium stone with two living eyes. It blinks, it follows your finger on the glass, it dozes off when it's left alone. And it talks with the AI you already have.
soul.hero_pos: your own AI · no camera · memory on the device
soul.m2: listens only while you hold the glass
soul.alive_lead: No app to open, no account, no internet needed. Everything you see on the glass runs on the stone itself, and keeps running if the Wi-Fi never comes back.
soul.alive_c1p: At random, never on a timer. Sometimes twice, when it's curious.
soul.alive_c2p: It follows your finger on the glass (and your cursor here), and dozes off when it's left alone.
soul.alive_c3p_html: Happy, sleepy, suspicious, șmecher. Tap it and see what you get.
soul.obj_lead: Its shape is called MĂRGĂRITAR: a pebble with soft shoulders at the crown, cut from aluminium and finished like a river stone. One round black glass. Nothing else on the front: no logo, no buttons.
soul.col_h2_html:
you pick the body.
the eyes pick themselves.
soul.col_same: Every colour costs the same. Bead-blasted, anodised aluminium 6061 with a black glass face.
soul.col_fam: Graphite, Ember, Silver, Midnight, Champagne. Five bodies, five different pairs of eyes. Tap any glass.
soul.born_lead: At first power-on, each SOUL is born from its chip's unique ID. The eyes it gets are the eyes it keeps. Nobody picks them. Not even us.
soul.born_sample: A sample birth. Type any chip ID to see exactly what that chip would be born as: the same math runs on the real SOUL.
soul.born_oddscap: Odds of each rarity at birth
soul.born_oddsnote: These are the real odds from the birth code. Inside a rarity, every design is equally likely. Rarity changes only the eyes: every SOUL does exactly the same things.
soul.ai_h2_html:
bring your own ai.
it gets a body.
soul.ai_lead: SOUL connects to the AI you already use, on your own account. We never sell AI and never include it. Or keep it offline: it's still alive.
soul.ai_c_p: Use your own Anthropic API key and talk to it by holding the glass.
soul.ai_c_l1: your own Anthropic API key (from the Anthropic Console)
soul.ai_c_l2: add SOUL as a custom connector in the Claude app: ask Claude to put a plan, a reminder or a note on it
soul.ai_g_p: Works with your own OpenAI API key (in development). You pay OpenAI directly, not us.
soul.ai_g_l1: own OpenAI API key: in development
soul.ai_g_l2: “Sign in with ChatGPT”: pending OpenAI approval
soul.ai_o_p: No AI, no sign-up, ever. The eyes, the moods, notes, reminders, alarms and focus all live on the stone.
soul.ai_m_t: SOUL Memory lives on the device.
soul.ai_m_p: What it remembers about you stays in the stone, in plain words you can read and delete. When you talk, it goes along to whichever AI you connected, so you can switch AIs without starting over.
soul.ai_note: SOUL is in development and these connections are being built. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic; ChatGPT is a trademark of OpenAI. SOUL is independent and not affiliated with or endorsed by either.
soul.hold_idle: Hold the glass (or the button) and SOUL listens. Let go and it answers.
soul.hold_note: A scripted demo, not a live AI. On the real SOUL the microphone is on only while your finger is on the glass. Space or Enter also works.
soul.os_lead: Touch the glass and the eyes glide up to become the face of every screen. Pure black, flat colour, chunky round shapes: the same language as the eyes and the stone.
soul.os_fig: Screens from the SoulOS web prototype, 480 × 480
soul.os_c1t: a dial made for a circle
soul.os_c1: Your apps sit around the eyes like small stones. Turn the ring with a finger. Nothing gets cut off by the round edge.
soul.os_c2: Open a map, a note or your AI: the eyes move to the top of the circle and keep reacting. They never leave the screen.
soul.os_c3t: colours from the eyes it was born with
soul.os_c3: Each SOUL's screens take their colours from its own pair of eyes and its aluminium body. Here: Sunday Toast eyes on Midnight.
soul.os_c4: Two black lids close for a moment, the screen changes behind them, and they open on your app. Going back is the same blink, in reverse.
soul.os_sb: No clock, no glow, no notifications staring at you. In standby, SOUL shows only its eyes on pure black.
soul.os_ctap: The SoulOS prototype runs right here in your browser. The same design is being built into SOUL's firmware.
soul.night_hint: tap to wake it. it won't love that.
soul.night_h2_html:
at night,
it sleeps in its egg.
soul.night_l1: Gold contacts in its foot. Set it in OU and it charges. No cable on the stone.
soul.night_l2: The warm glow comes from the egg, not from the screen.
soul.night_l3: Asleep in OU it doesn't listen. It only hears you while your finger is on the glass.
soul.pr1p: There is no camera in SOUL. The eyes are only for looking back.
soul.pr2t: it listens only while you hold the glass.
soul.pr2p: No wake word, no always-on microphone. Lift your finger and it stops.
soul.pr3p: SOUL Memory lives on the device, in plain words, one tap from gone.
soul.pr4t: only to the AI you chose.
soul.pr4p: Your words go to the AI you connected, on your account. Offline, nothing leaves the stone. No ads, and we never sell your data.
soul.pr5t: it always says it's an AI.
soul.pr5p: No pretending to be a person, no streaks, no guilt trips, no sulking for attention.
soul.pr6p: Its personality runs on the device. If we ever disappear, we publish the firmware. 16+, not a toy.
soul.sp_v1: round 1.75″ AMOLED, 466 × 466, true black, under flat Ø52 glass
soul.sp_v5: one of 120 designs, decided at birth
soul.sp_v7: your Claude, your ChatGPT, or offline
soul.sp_v8: hold the glass to talk; speaker in the side seam
soul.sp_v10: in OU, its egg, through contacts in its foot
soul.box_1p: in the colour you choose, with the eyes it chooses
soul.box_note: The final list, battery life and accessories will be published before reservations open.
soul.sp_note: All product images are concept renders, not photos. Specifications describe the design in development and may change before production.
soul.a1: Not yet. SOUL has Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, so it must pass CE testing (the EU Radio Equipment Directive) at an accredited lab before anyone can sell it. It isn't CE-certified yet. Until then there is only a waitlist: no payment, no pre-orders, no deposits.
soul.a2: Not to us. SOUL is alive offline, with no account. For AI, you connect your own Claude or ChatGPT, on your own account or API key, and pay them directly. We never sell or include AI.
soul.q3: Which AI does it work with?
soul.a3: Claude: your own Anthropic API key, plus SOUL as a custom connector in the Claude app. ChatGPT: your own OpenAI API key (in development); “Sign in with ChatGPT” is pending OpenAI's approval. Or no AI at all. SOUL is in development, and these connections are being built.
soul.a4: The things SOUL remembers about you: names, plans, preferences. It lives on the device, in plain words you can read and delete. When you talk, it goes along to whichever AI you connected, so switching AIs doesn't mean starting over.
soul.q5: Does it listen all the time? Does it have a camera?
soul.a5: No and no. It listens only while your finger is on the glass. There is no wake word and no camera.
soul.a6: No, and that's the fun. You choose the colour of the body. The eyes are decided once, at first power-on, from the chip's unique ID: one of 120 designs, some much rarer than others. The odds are published above.
soul.q7: Does it work away from home?
soul.a7: Yes. Offline it's always alive. For AI it needs Wi-Fi, and it can roam on your phone's hotspot.
soul.q8: How long does the battery last?
soul.a8: We'll publish measured battery life before we ask anyone to pay. It charges in OU, its egg.
soul.a9: No. SOUL is made for adults and teens 16 and over. It contains small parts and a lithium battery.
soul.a10: ARTEMIS DIGITAL S.R.L., in Bucharest, Romania. Designed in Romania. We'll name our manufacturing partners before we ask anyone to pay.
soul.res_h2: be there when it opens its eyes.
soul.res_lead: Leave your email. We'll write when reservations open, before anyone else. No payment, no pre-order.
soul.res_consent_html: I agree to receive emails about SOUL from ARTEMIS DIGITAL S.R.L. and can unsubscribe at any time. Read the Privacy Notice.
soul.res_fine: Nothing is charged here. One email when reservations open, and the odd update before.
soul.res_tp: It just smiled at you. We'll write before anyone else.
